content.title: Watch Justin Bieber Bring Out SZA and Billie Eilish at Coachella
content.text: Sexyy Red, Dijon, and Big Sean also joined Bieber onstage for his Weekend Two setJustin Bieber, photo by Kevin Mazur/Getty ImagesJustin Bieber once again headlined Coachella on Saturday, April 20, and brought a host of special guests with him. He sang his “Snooze” remix with SZA, his Swag songs “Sweet Spot” with Sexyy Red and “Devotion” with Dijon, and “As Long As You Love Me” and “No Pressure” with Big Sean. He also brought up dedicated Belieber Billie Eilish during a performance of “One Less Lonely Girl,” reigniting a tradition that dates back to his early touring days. Watch footage from the occasion below.At his set last weekend, Bieber brought out Tems, Wizkid, the Kid Laroi, Mk.Gee, and Dijon. His Weekend Two show followed the same format as Weekend One’s, opening with a number of new songs before Bieber busted out a laptop to revisit some of his biggest early-career hits. New additions this time around included “U Smile,” his first big hit, “One Time,” and a cover of Justin Timberlake’s “Cry Me a River” (“I’m proud of you—and you should be proud of you too,” Timberlake said on Instagram). He closed the night out with “Daisies.”Bieber released Swag in July 2025, following it up with a sequel in September.
